tasks.instruction: A muscular blue tiger kneels beside a low wooden stool and pushes a flat loaf of bread onto a small clay plate with one open palm, looking down at the plate as crumbs scatter.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pushing hand is fully open and in frame; the other arm is tucked behind the torso and not countable.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在凳旁用张开的手掌把面包推上盘子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back under a low shelf, both arms reaching up to balance a round woven basket on one flat palm while the other hand rests open across its chest.
tasks.camera: low angle from feet, wide shot
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands open and visible; the chest hand shows all five fingers clearly against the fur.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺用张开的手掌平衡编织篮

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a floor cushion, the blue tiger holds a large map fully spread across its lap, one hand open and flat pinning a corner while the head tilts to study the lines.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pinning hand is flat and unobstructed on the map corner; the opposite hand is under the map.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿坐着摊开地图用手掌压住一角

tasks.instruction: The tiger stands at a tall wooden shelf and slides a thick book into a gap with one extended open palm, fingers together, while peering sideways at the row of spines.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pushing palm faces the camera in profile, all digits separated and clear; the other arm hangs out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在书架边用平掌把书推入缝隙

tasks.instruction: Crouching near a garden bed, the blue tiger presses one open palm gently onto a mound of dark soil to firm it, tail curled behind, face turned toward a young seedling.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter shot from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The soil-pressing palm is fully visible with all fingers spread; the other hand is behind the knee.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在花圃边用平掌压紧泥土

tasks.instruction: The tiger perches on a wide windowsill, one leg dangling, and uses a flat open hand to wipe condensation from the glass in a broad arc, breath fogging a fresh patch.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Wiping hand flat against glass, palm toward viewer, five digits visible; other hand grips the sill out of view.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在窗台用平掌擦去玻璃上的水雾

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a wooden tub, the blue tiger scoops water with one cupped-but-open hand and lets it fall in a thin stream, head turned to avoid splashes.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The scooping hand is above the rim, fingers clear and separated; the second hand steadies the tub below frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身木盆边用手掌舀水倾泻

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on a rug, the tiger holds a small hand mirror at arm's length and turns it to catch light, one open palm flat beneath the mirror to steady it.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The supporting palm is fully open and visible under the mirror; the gripping hand is behind the mirror edge.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着拿小镜子照光，平掌托住镜底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stretches one arm across a doorway to press a flat open palm against the frame, measuring its width, while looking up along the wood grain.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The measuring palm is flat against the frame with all five fingers spread and unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 伸手用平掌测量门框宽度

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low wall, the tiger tilts its head back and places a flat open palm across its brow to shade its eyes, gazing across a bright courtyard.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The shading palm is fully open above the eyes, fingers clear against the sky.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在矮墙上用平掌遮阳远望

tasks.instruction: Crouched by a campfire, the blue tiger holds one open palm out toward the flames to warm it, fingers relaxed and spread, firelight across the fur.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The warming palm faces the fire and camera, all digits distinct; the other arm is braced on the ground out of view.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁平掌向火取暖

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a hammock, the tiger reaches down with one open hand to pluck a leaf from a passing branch, body swinging slightly, other arm hooked over the hammock rope.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The plucking hand is open and clear below the hammock edge; the hooked arm is partially hidden by rope.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺吊床上伸手摘叶子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands before a tall mirror and presses an open palm flat against its reflection, fingers aligned to the reflected digits, head tilted curiously.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The real palm is flat and fully visible; the reflected hand shows the same five digits for comparison.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在镜前平掌贴镜比对指形

tasks.instruction: Half-turned at a kitchen counter, the tiger flattens one open hand to press a dough ball into a disc, leaning weight onto it, flour dusting the wood.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressing palm is fully open and unobstructed on the dough; the other hand gathers flour off-frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 在厨房台面用平掌压扁面团

tasks.instruction: The tiger straddles a low beam and reaches one open hand out to catch a dangling rope tassel, fingers spread wide, eyes focused on the swinging end.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The reaching palm is fully open with all five fingers visible against the background; the other hand grips the beam.
tasks.intent_zh: 跨坐横梁伸手抓晃动的绳穗

tasks.instruction: Leaning out of a small boat, the blue tiger lowers one flat open hand toward the water surface to feel the current, the other hand trailing a paddle behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The trailing palm is open and above water, digits clear; the paddle hand is behind the body.
tasks.intent_zh: 从船边俯身用平掌探水流

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses one open palm against a large leaf to fold it over a bundle of herbs, kneeling in tall grass, tongue slightly out in concentration.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The folding palm is open on the leaf, five fingers distinct against green; the other hand is hidden beneath the bundle.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在草丛用平掌折叶包草药

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a stack of crates, the tiger uses a flat open palm to smooth a crumpled cloth across its knee, pressing corner by corner with deliberate care.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The smoothing palm is fully visible and flat on the cloth; the other hand steadies the cloth at the knee but is angled away.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在木箱上用平掌抚平布褶

tasks.instruction: The tiger hangs from a stout branch with one hand and swings an open palm down to tap a hanging bell, body angled in mid-air, tail counterbalancing.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The bell-tapping palm is wide open and clear; the gripping hand shows all digits wrapped but visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 单手悬挂摆身用平掌敲铃

tasks.instruction: Crouched low behind a bush, the blue tiger parts branches with one flat open hand to peer through, ears forward, keeping perfectly still.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The parting palm is open and fully visible framing the gap; the other hand stays on the ground out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在灌木后用平掌拨开枝条窥看

tasks.instruction: The tiger sits on a rug and lays one open palm flat on a drumhead, pressing lightly to test the tension, head cocked toward the sound.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The palm on the drum is fully open with all digits visible; the second hand holds a beater off to the side and out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐着用平掌按鼓面试张力

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a fence rail, the blue tiger extends one open palm toward a curious goat, fingers steady and relaxed, waiting for it to sniff.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The offered palm is fully open and clear toward the animal; the other arm rests over the rail out of view.
tasks.intent_zh: 倚着栅栏平掌伸向山羊

tasks.instruction: The tiger kneels to press one flat open palm on a large floor tile, checking if it wobbles, brow furrowed, tail flicking behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressing palm is flat and entirely visible on the tile; the other hand balances on the knee but is turned away.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪地用手掌按压地砖查松动

tasks.instruction: Sitting sideways on a broad tree stump, the blue tiger rests one open palm on a carved wooden bowl of seeds, lifting a few with fingertips.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The palm is open above the bowl with seeds resting in it, all fingers visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在树桩上用平掌托起碗中种子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies prone on a flat rock and reaches one open hand over the edge to touch rippling pond water, chin on its other forearm.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The water-touching palm is open and clear above the ripples; the supporting forearm is tucked beneath the chin.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在岩石边伸手触碰池水

tasks.instruction: Standing on tiptoe, the tiger stretches one open palm up to press a high cupboard door shut, body elongated, gaze following the swinging door.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pushing palm is open and flat against the door, digits clear; the other arm hangs down out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 踮脚用平掌推上高柜门

tasks.instruction: The tiger sits at a low table and slides an open palm across a sheet of paper to flatten its curling edge, other elbow on the table.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The sliding palm is fully flat and visible on the paper; the resting elbow hand is out of the frame edge.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐矮桌边用平掌抚平卷边纸张

tasks.instruction: Crouched beside a stream, the blue tiger holds one open palm beneath a trickling spout to catch water, droplets beading on the yellow pads.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The catching palm faces up to camera with all five fingers and pads clearly visible; other hand braces on a stone.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲溪边用掌心接住细流

tasks.instruction: The tiger leans around a corner of a stone wall and places one flat open palm on the cool surface, peeking ahead with ears swiveled.
tasks.visibility_requirement: The wall palm is flat and fully visible; the rest of the body is angled away with the second hand hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 绕墙角用平掌扶石墙探头张望
